headline: Pebbling branch
title: Pebbling Evolution | Lavazar or Geodeback | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Pebbling has two paths at level thirty eight. Lavazar is the fiery one. At level forty eight, after a soak in a hot spring, it becomes Magmarex. Geodeback is the other path, and it becomes Minespine at level forty eight. A Pebbling can only take one path, so raise two if you want both. Magmarex or Minespine? Comment below!
description: Pebbling evolves at level 38 into Lavazar or Geodeback. Lavazar becomes Magmarex at 48 after a hot spring soak; Geodeback becomes Minespine at 48.
